title: Trophies
blurb: Hang what you have beaten, and hold home when a gate breaks near it.

steps.text: Hang a boss trophy on a Trophy Mount.
steps.hint: The first time you beat each Gate Lord it drops its trophy.
Each different boss in it adds 1% damage and half a heart.

steps.text: Hold a gate break near home.
steps.hint: The Hearth shields you while it lasts.

finish.line: Your home has a hall of what you have beaten, and it held.
